equations.label: Son 2017 Eq. (1) movable-pintle minimum orifice area
equations.quote: was estimated and geometrically calculated according to Eq
equations.description: Minimum orifice area at the post tip of a movable pintle as a function of opening distance; valid until it reaches the fixed center-gap area A_cg (transition point).

variables.meaning: minimum orifice area inside the pintle nozzle

assumptions: post angle small enough that the minimum area is always at the post tip (post angle fixed at 30 deg)
validity: opening distances below the transition point where A_min reaches A_cg

claims.subject: movable pintle small opening
claims.object: a uniform liquid sheet within 0.1 mm opening distance; experiments started at 0.2 mm in 0.1 mm steps
claims.statement: In the spray experiment the uniform liquid sheet was not formed within 0.1 mm of opening distance, so the experimental opening distance was controlled from 0.2 mm at 0.1 mm intervals.
claims.quote: uniform liquid sheet was not constructed within 0.1 mmof the opening

claims.subject: minimum-area transition
claims.object: pintle tip angle; beyond it the minimum area becomes the fixed center-gap area
claims.statement: A_min equals the constant center-gap area A_cg at a transition point beyond which the minimum area no longer changes with opening; transition points increase with pintle tip angle.
